//: What the `confirm` effect opens: a question over whatever asked it, with the two answers. A profile names it for the role `confirm`. `answer` closes it and tells the effect that is waiting; Esc answers no.
title: Confirm

//: What the `pick` effect opens for a list: one row for each entry, shown as the effect's `item` says. A profile names it for the role `picker.list`. Activating a row answers with that entry; Esc leaves without choosing. It is also the picker for a parameter chosen from a list, and then the selection starts on the value the parameter is filled in with; and the list an action is picked from, where an entry that cannot be done now (`available` false) is greyed with `why`, and choosing it is refused with that reason.
title: Choose

list.item: {if has(it, 'available') and it.available == false then '' else it.label}<dim>{if has(it, 'available') and it.available == false then it.label + ': ' + it.why else ''}</>
list.empty: There is nothing to choose from.
